en.headline: Standard Chartered third-quarter profit rises 46 per cent, lifts outlook
en.dek: The note-issuing bank reported net profit of US$1.5 billion for the quarter to September 30, beating forecasts on stronger wealth and trade income, and raised full-year income growth guidance.
body: Standard Chartered reported on Wednesday that its third-quarter net profit rose 46 per cent to US$1.5 billion, or 68.9 US cents per share, from US$1.03 billion a year earlier.

Pretax profit increased 27 per cent to US$2.25 billion. Operating income climbed 13 per cent to US$5.78 billion, driven by wealth management and cross-border trade lending, the bank said in a filing to the Hong Kong stock exchange.
The result exceeded analysts’ expectations. The bank raised its full-year 2026 income growth guidance above the previous 5-7 per cent range and lifted its return on tangible equity target.

Chief executive Bill Winters said the quarter showed broad-based growth as the bank captured structural shifts in trade, investment and wealth creation. Hong Kong-listed shares rose after the announcement.

zh.headline: 渣打第三季純利升百分之四十六 上調全年收入指引
zh.dek: 這家發鈔銀行截至9月30日止季度純利達15億美元，優於預期，受財富管理及貿易貸款帶動，並提高全年收入增長預測。
body: 渣打周三公布，第三季純利按年上升百分之四十六至15億美元，每股盈利68.9美仙，去年同期為10.3億美元。
除稅前溢利上升百分之二十七至22.5億美元。營運收入按年上升百分之十三至57.8億美元，主要由財富管理及跨境貿易貸款帶動，銀行向港交所提交的文件顯示。
業績優於分析師預期。銀行將2026年全年收入增長指引上調至高於原先百分之五至七的範圍，並提高有形股本回報率目標。
行政總裁溫拓思表示，季度顯示廣泛增長，銀行正把握貿易、投資及財富創造的結構性轉變。港股上市股份在公布後上升。
